inspection.method: 24 campus far-region RAW/draft paired crops, full RAW X01/X11/X13/X25/X43/X49/F056 and signed PETS550; full draft overlays X01-X04; prior findings retained without claiming exhaustive new visual review
inspection.scope: Only the explicitly resolved region indices and modified box below are new positive AI conclusions. Unlisted image regions are not certified complete.

resolved_region_basis: Campus X07/X09/X10/X12/X13/X14/X16-X23 listed vehicle hints align with the pale bench/step and handrails, sometimes overlapping existing person's visible limbs (e.g. X12 o6). They do not establish an independent vehicle. This does not declare the entire rectangle background: existing person labels and new person holds remain. These hints were already withheld from positive vehicle labels; this closes only their independent-vehicle doubt, not all frame labels.

VIRAT_S_010204_05_000856_000890_f0000023.reason: AI full RAW: tighten the visible dark-clothed person at the left flowerbed; original box included a broad plant margin and hidden lower-body area. Draft only, no human signature inherited.

VIRAT_S_010204_05_000856_000890_f0000163.reason: AI RAW enlarged crop: a separate blue-clothed person is visible at the steps behind/right of the far group; existing source o10/o12 boxes are elsewhere. Add visible-person draft; not inferred from a vehicle hint, not human GT.

VIRAT_S_010204_05_000856_000890_f0000023.reason: Original ignore o8 lies at the backpack/arm and foreground-person boundary. Full RAW crop does not establish a separate target. Retain semantic uncertainty; do not silently delete it or declare it background.

VIRAT_S_010204_05_000856_000890_f0000349.reason: RAW enlarged crop: o10/o11/o12 overlap the far white-backpack/blue-clothed people. Empty old uncertain list did not prove these are distinct people. Exclude frame until multiplicity and per-person extent are resolved.

VIRAT_S_010204_05_000856_000890_f0000209.reason: After rejecting the vehicle interpretation, RAW still contains a moving blue-clothed person beside the steps. Existing far-source boxes do not establish complete per-person extent; keep a person coverage hold, not background.

exclusion_policy.construction_dev: All 47 VIRAT050000 development drafts withdrawn from this experiment: broad unresolved tree-occlusion/vehicle-class extent and unfinished full-frame labels. Not selected by student accuracy; source files retained.
exclusion_policy.holds: Any unresolved supervision region excludes the entire frame from this experiment, not a new mask or ignore. Keep raw labels and prior user edits.
exclusion_policy.MIO: 15 signed images retained separately, but not admitted to a strict frozen-camera manifest because physical camera IDs remain unknown. Entire MIO family remains train-only; unknown IDs do not mean proven leakage.
exclusion_policy.unsigned: No teacher/AI draft is promoted into human GT, even when no explicit holds remain.
exclusion_policy.stress_and_blind: Original stress6 and unsigned2 remain outside this 192 pool; no blind/reserve assets decoded or parsed.

blockers: 156 of 192 candidate images were new unsigned AI drafts; resolving some uncertainty does not create human-complete labels.
Existing main reviewed development is only 5 images: A1/C4, person14/vehicle63/ignore2, not a reliable A-domain G100 selection set.
After unresolved-region and unknown-camera exclusions, signed train candidates are only EPFL10 with few people and one synchronized recording family; not the planned reliable road adaptation pilot.
Historical/physical camera exclusion has not been fully certified; conservative family reservation is not a full camera proof.
Frozen scope forbids silently increasing the user's review workload. Any new review/source allocation or smaller diagnostic-only experiment needs a specific consolidated decision.
